run_model.buffer: 1 hour validation, breath, recovery, and blocker handling

hard_boundaries: Do not open v491+ without explicit Hamish instruction.
Do not retry or replace Kimi without explicit restoration confirmation.
Do not treat advisory App lanes as CLI receipt replacements.
Do not mutate external services, spend money, expose secrets, stage raw logs, or stage raw source documents.
Use fetch, drift check, curated staging, validation, commit, push, and remote-equals-local verification before closeout.
If stale automation path appears, treat as Codex app resume-path vitality, not repo failure.

agent_report_policy.app_lanes: Elaborate evidence-first advisory reports by default; compact receipts only for emergency, blocker, or explicit quick-check contexts.
agent_report_policy.cli_lanes: Arby and Aster Vale run through their CLI/worktree lanes, not callable IDs, unless the CLI itself exposes a real callable ID.
agent_report_policy.no_false_callability: Do not invent callable IDs for CLI lanes.

next_phase_policy: Advance only one v1/v2 pair per 3-hour heartbeat unless Hamish explicitly requests a larger batch.
